newsitem.title: USA: Comair confirms crash near Detroit.
newsitem.headline: Comair confirms crash near Detroit.

text.p: COMAIR Holdings Inc said one of its aircraft crashed at about 1630 EST/2130 GMT on Thursday while flying between Cincinnati and Detroit.

COMAIR said preliminary information indicates there were 26 passengers and a crew of three aboard flight 3272, a 30-seat Embraer Brasilia 120 commuter aircraft. No confirmed totals of injuries or fatalities were immediately available, it said.
COMAIR said it has activated its emergency response team and will cooperate fully with investigating authorities.
Another team of COMAIR management employees will contact family members and provide them with whatever assistance is necessary, the company said.

Names of passengers and crew members will be released as their identities are confirmed and family members have been notified. It is expected that the first group of names will not be available for at least several hours, COMAIR said.
COMAIR said it will issue further information as details become available. Family members seeking information on passengers should call 800-801-0088.
